tie_reference: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.
source_note: Verified English Language Form Two lesson plans (Arusha Catholic Seminary). 21 lesson plans covering Listening Skills, Producing Oral Messages, Vocabulary, Grammar and Vocabulary, Reading Comprehension (Term I), then Reading Comprehension, Comprehending Oral Messages, Responding to Communication and Comprehensive Review (Term II). One verified lesson per teaching week (3 periods each); weeks for mid-term assessments, FTNA revision and annual examinations carry no teaching content and are intentionally omitted. Content kept verbatim from the educator-verified source for offline and AI generation grounding.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 1: PARTICIPATE IN CONVERSATIONS
lessons.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of listening skills
lessons.specific_activity: Participate in different conversations
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Audio clips, dialogue scripts, pair-work cue cards.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks students to greet a partner and introduce themselves; links conversation norms to everyday life.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Greet partners and share one personal detail.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Willingness to speak and listen to partners.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Plays a short recorded conversation and models how to take turns, ask for clarification and respond appropriately.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Listen to the clip and identify the speakers' conversational moves.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct identification of openings, questions and responses.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides pairs through dialogue scripts using cue cards; circulates to correct pronunciation and turn-taking.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Role-play short conversations on given topics (school, family, hobbies).
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Fluent turn-taking with appropriate questions and answers.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Selects pairs to present their dialogue; gives feedback and uses a listening checklist to assess participation.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Present dialogues and reflect on what made conversations effective.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Active participation and use of learned conversational phrases.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 2: SUMMARIZE ORAL PRESENTATIONS
lessons.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of listening skills
lessons.specific_activity: Summarize information from oral presentations
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Recorded speeches, summary cues, listening stations.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks students what they do after listening to a radio or school announcement; introduces 'summary'.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Share what they remember from recent spoken messages.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition of the need to capture key ideas.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Plays a recorded speech; models how to pick main points, ignore details and say ideas in one or two sentences.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Note main ideas while listening and compare notes with a partner.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct identification of the speaker's main points.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Runs listen-and-summarize drills: pairs retell the speech in their own words using summary cues.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Produce oral summaries of short recorded presentations.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Summaries capture main ideas accurately and concisely.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Reviews summaries orally, clarifies omissions and conducts a summary evaluation.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Present summaries and self-correct against the main-point list.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Ability to summarize oral information clearly.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 3: PARAPHRASE ORAL INFORMATION
lessons.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of listening skills
lessons.specific_activity: Paraphrase oral information accurately
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Audio recordings, paraphrase prompts, word banks.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Says one sentence and asks a student to say the same idea differently; introduces 'paraphrase'.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Try to re-word a simple sentence given by the teacher.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition that different words can carry the same meaning.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Plays short audio clips and models paraphrasing techniques: synonyms, change of sentence structure, keeping meaning.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Listen and note alternative expressions for key ideas.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct use of synonyms without changing the meaning.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides listen-and-paraphrase exercises where partners express each other's statements differently.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Paraphrase recorded sentences and short passages in pairs.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Meaning preserved with appropriate vocabulary choices.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Administers a short paraphrase test and gives corrective feedback.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Paraphrase a final audio sentence in writing and self-check.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Accurate paraphrasing of oral information.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 4: USE PROPER INTONATION
lessons.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of producing oral messages
lessons.specific_activity: Construct sentences with proper intonation
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Intonation audio samples, sentence strips, mirrors for mouth movement.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Says 'You are coming.' then 'You are coming?' and asks what changed; introduces rising and falling tone.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Notice the difference between statement and question tone.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition of pitch change between sentences.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Plays intonation samples; explains falling tone (statements, wH-questions) and rising tone (yes/no questions), modeling each.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Repeat samples, imitating pitch patterns.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct imitation of rise and fall patterns.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides pronunciation drills and reading aloud of sentence strips, marking intonation arrows on the board.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Read sentences aloud with correct intonation in pairs.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Appropriate rise or fall in the practiced sentences.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Assesses individual reading aloud, corrects errors and summarizes the patterns.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Read a final set of sentences aloud for an oral assessment.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Confident use of correct intonation for meaning.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 5: USE COHESIVE DEVICES
lessons.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of producing oral messages
lessons.specific_activity: Use cohesive devices in oral presentations
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Sample speech transcripts, cohesive-device charts, presentation rubric.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Reads a speech without connectors, then with them; asks which version flows better.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Compare the two versions and state the difference.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition that linking words make speech flow.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Introduces cohesive devices (first, then, however, therefore, finally) and shows how they connect ideas in a speech.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Underline cohesive devices in sample transcripts.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct identification of cohesive devices.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides guided speech practice: students outline a short talk about their day using sequence and contrast links.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Prepare and rehearse a short speech using cohesive devices.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Appropriate linking of ideas in the speech outline.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Assesses short presentations with the presentation rubric and gives feedback on flow.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Deliver the short speech to a partner or group.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Clear, connected oral presentation using cohesive devices.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 6: RECOGNIZE ANTONYMS
lessons.main_competence: 3.0 Demonstrate mastery of vocabulary
lessons.specific_activity: Recognize words with opposite meanings
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Vocabulary flashcards, matching-game cards, antonym word wall.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Writes 'hot' and asks students for its opposite; introduces the term 'antonym'.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Brainstorm opposites for common adjectives.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Ability to produce obvious opposites.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Presents word pairs from the flashcards (big/small, happy/sad, early/late) and discusses their meanings.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take notes and match word pairs on the word wall.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct matching of antonym pairs.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Organizes a matching game in groups; students race to pair words with their opposites.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Play the matching game and record new pairs.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Speed and accuracy in forming antonym pairs.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Gives a short matching quiz and reinforces the concept with examples.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Complete the quiz and self-correct.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct recognition of antonyms.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 7: USE AFFIXES
lessons.main_competence: 3.0 Demonstrate mastery of vocabulary
lessons.specific_activity: Produce new vocabulary using prefixes and suffixes
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Word lists, worksheets, affix chart (un-, re-, dis-, -ful, -less, -er).
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Writes 'happy' and 'unhappy'; asks what the beginning of the second word does to meaning.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Identify the change in meaning caused by 'un-'.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition that prefixes change word meaning.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Explains prefixes and suffixes with examples: un-, re-, dis-, -ful, -less, -er; shows meaning shifts.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take notes and form new words from root words.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct formation of affixed words.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides word-building exercises from word lists and worksheets; students create sentences with the new words.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Build words and write short sentences using them.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Accurate use of prefixes and suffixes in context.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Administers a word-formation test and corrects common errors.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Complete the test and review mistakes.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct production of affixed vocabulary.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 8: DESCRIBE PERSONAL EXPERIENCES
lessons.main_competence: 4.0 Demonstrate mastery of grammar and vocabulary
lessons.specific_activity: Produce contextualized descriptions of personal experiences
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Writing prompts, sample model texts, grammar reference sheet.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks students to describe their last weekend in two sentences; links to descriptive writing.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Share short descriptions of personal experiences.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Willingness to describe personal events.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Presents a model paragraph describing an experience; highlights time markers, past tense and descriptive words.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Read the model and note the language used.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct identification of descriptive features.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides a writing exercise: students write a short paragraph about an experience using the model and writing prompts.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Draft their own contextualized descriptions.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Use of past tense and descriptive vocabulary.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Collects samples, reviews them and assigns peer feedback before a written assessment.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Reflect on feedback and improve their paragraphs.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Clear, accurate description of a personal experience.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 9: COMPOSE CONTEXTUAL PASSAGES
lessons.main_competence: 4.0 Demonstrate mastery of grammar and vocabulary
lessons.specific_activity: Compose a passage from a specific context
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Sample passages, context cards, composition rubric.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Shows a picture of a market scene; asks students what a passage about it should include.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Brainstorm content related to the context.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Generation of ideas tied to the given context.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Explains how to organize a passage: beginning, body, ending; models one on the board using a context card.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Read sample passages and identify their structure.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Understanding of paragraph organization.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides a composition task: each student composes a passage from their context card, then exchanges with a partner for peer review.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Compose the passage and give peer feedback.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Coherent passage matching the given context.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Evaluates compositions, highlights strengths and assigns improvement tasks.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Revise their passages based on feedback.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Completed, contextually appropriate composition.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 10: PRESENT MESSAGES ACCURATELY
lessons.main_competence: 4.0 Demonstrate mastery of grammar and vocabulary
lessons.specific_activity: Present messages using correct grammar and vocabulary
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Rubric sheets, topic cards, grammar checklist.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks students to give a group-mate a short school notice; asks why accuracy matters.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Deliver and receive short messages.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition that grammar mistakes alter meaning.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Reviews common grammar and vocabulary errors; models a clear presentation of a message with correct structure.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take notes on the checklist of accuracy points.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct use of the reviewed grammar points.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Conducts oral presentations in small groups with peer feedback against the rubric.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Present messages using topic cards and respond to peer feedback.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Accurate, clear oral presentation.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Completes the presentation assessment and summarizes common areas for improvement.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Reflect on feedback and note corrections.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Improved accuracy in presenting messages.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 11: IDENTIFY MAIN IDEAS
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of reading comprehension
lessons.specific_activity: Express the main ideas from texts
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Reading passages, main-idea cue cards, comprehension questions.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Reads the title and first sentence of a passage; asks what the passage is probably about.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Predict the main idea from the opening.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Sensible predictions based on text clues.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides guided reading; models finding the main idea by looking at topic sentences and the title.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Read silently and underline key sentences.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct location of main-idea sentences.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Organizes group discussion; groups summarize each paragraph's idea using cue cards then state the whole-text main idea.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Discuss and express main ideas from the text.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Accurate expression of paragraph and text main ideas.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Administers a comprehension test on identifying main ideas and reviews answers.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Complete the comprehension test and self-correct.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct identification of main ideas.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 12: INFER MEANINGS FROM TEXTS
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of reading comprehension
lessons.specific_activity: Infer meanings from texts
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Reading passages, inference prompts, context-clue worksheets.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Shows a picture of an umbrella and wet road; asks what the sky looked like—introduces 'reading between the lines'.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Make guesses based on the picture clues.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition that meaning can be implied.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Explains inference using context clues: synonyms, examples, contrast; models with a passage.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Follow the model and note clue words.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Use of context to deduce word meaning.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides inference exercises: students read short passages and answer questions requiring deduction from context.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Complete inference questions and justify answers with evidence.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Inferences supported by textual evidence.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Administers an inference test and reviews strategies used.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Complete the test and share the clues they used.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct inferred meanings from texts.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 13: RELATE TEXTS TO REAL LIFE
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of reading comprehension
lessons.specific_activity: Relate messages from texts to real-life experiences
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Reading passages, reflection prompts, discussion questions.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks students if they have ever learned a lesson from a story; connects reading to daily life.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Share personal connections to stories.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Willingness to relate reading to life.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides group discussion of a passage: what it teaches and how it connects to students' lives.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Read the passage and discuss real-life applications.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition of the text's relevance to daily life.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Structures reflection writing: students write how the message applies to their community or school.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Write short reflections connecting the text to real experience.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Meaningful personal connections expressed in writing.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Collects reflections and leads a brief sharing session; assesses understanding.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Share reflections with the class.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Reflection demonstrates genuine understanding.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 14: SYNTHESIZE ORAL IDEAS
lessons.main_competence: 6.0 Demonstrate mastery of comprehending oral messages
lessons.specific_activity: Synthesize ideas from a variety of oral sources
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Audio/video clips, listening stations, synthesis guide chart.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks students to give two ideas they heard today; explains that combining ideas from many sources is synthesis.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: List ideas from different sources they encountered.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition of combining ideas.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Plays two short clips on one topic; models combining their key ideas into one coherent account.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Listen to the clips and note each source's key ideas.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Extraction of key ideas from each source.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Runs listening stations; groups gather ideas from different sources and produce a combined summary.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Work in groups to synthesize the sources into one account.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Coherent synthesis that includes all sources.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Assesses group syntheses and administers a synthesis test.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Present combined summaries and complete the test.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Accurate synthesis of ideas from varied oral sources.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 15: SUMMARIZE ORAL SOURCES
lessons.main_competence: 6.0 Demonstrate mastery of comprehending oral messages
lessons.specific_activity: Summarize information from oral sources
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Recorded materials, note cards, summarizing checklist.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Plays a short announcement; asks students to tell a friend the news in one sentence.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Practise condensing a spoken message.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition of the need to condense information.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Reviews summarizing steps for oral material: listen, note key points, restate briefly in own words.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Listen to a recorded talk and jot key points.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Accurate capture of key points.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Runs listen-and-summarize drills in pairs using different recorded materials.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Summarize each recorded piece orally for a partner.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Concise, accurate oral summaries.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Conducts a summary evaluation with feedback on completeness and brevity.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Present summaries and refine them after feedback.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Ability to summarize oral sources accurately.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 16: PARTICIPATE IN CONTEXTUAL CONVERSATION
lessons.main_competence: 6.0 Demonstrate mastery of comprehending oral messages
lessons.specific_activity: Participate in contextualized oral conversation
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Dialogue scripts, role-play cards, participation checklist.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Sets a context: buying vegetables at the market; asks what people would say.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Suggest phrases for the market conversation.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Relevant language generated for the context.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Presents dialogue scripts for contexts (market, clinic, bus stand) and models the conversation flow.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Read the scripts and identify roles.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Understanding of context-appropriate phrases.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides role-play and group conversation using role-play cards for different contexts.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Act out the conversations in groups.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Appropriate language used in context.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Assesses participation with the checklist and gives feedback on appropriateness.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Reflect on their conversational performance.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Active, contextually appropriate participation.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 17: EXPRESS IDEAS AND OPINIONS
lessons.main_competence: 7.0 Demonstrate mastery of responding to communication
lessons.specific_activity: Express ideas and opinions in communicative settings
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Discussion topics, opinion-phrase charts, debate cards.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks 'Is homework useful?' and invites a show of hands; introduces opinion expressions.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: State and defend a simple opinion.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Willingness to state personal views.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Presents phrases for opinions (I think, In my view, I believe) and polite agreement/disagreement.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take notes and practise the phrases aloud.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct use of opinion expressions.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Runs a mini-debate and group discussion on simple issues using the topic cards.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Express and defend ideas and opinions in groups.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Clear expression of opinion with a supporting reason.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Assesses oral contributions and reinforces polite language use.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Reflect on their ability to express opinions.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Confident expression of ideas in discussion.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 18: USE NON-VERBAL CUES
lessons.main_competence: 7.0 Demonstrate mastery of responding to communication
lessons.specific_activity: Use appropriate non-verbal cues in group communication
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Video clips, observation checklist, scenario cards.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Greets the class silently with a smile and wave; asks what message was sent without words.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Identify the non-verbal message.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Recognition of communication without words.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Shows video clips and explains facial expressions, gestures, eye contact and posture in communication.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Watch clips and identify the non-verbal cues used.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct identification of non-verbal cues.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Runs role-play scenarios where students must convey messages using appropriate non-verbal cues.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Perform scenarios in groups while others observe.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Appropriate and clear use of non-verbal cues.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Records observations on the checklist and debriefs the class on cue usage.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Review the checklist and reflect on their performance.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Effective non-verbal communication in groups.

lessons.title: ENGLISH FORM TWO LESSON PLAN NO. 19: USE GRAMMAR AND VOCABULARY ORALLY
lessons.main_competence: 7.0 Demonstrate mastery of responding to communication
lessons.specific_competence: 7.3 Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary for oral communication
lessons.specific_activity: Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary for oral communication
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Rubric sheets, speaking prompts, grammar review chart.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). English Language Form 2 Student's Book. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks a student to tell yesterday's weather; listens for grammar and vocabulary use.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Speak briefly about a familiar topic.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Awareness of accurate language use.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Reviews key grammar (tenses, subject-verb agreement) and topic vocabulary; models accurate speech.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take notes and practise corrected sentences.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct use of reviewed structures.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides speaking practice with prompts; partners assess each other against the rubric.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Practise speaking accurately and give peer feedback.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Grammatically correct, vocabulary-rich speech.
